propositions: Documentation still teaches pre-330c behavior where checkbox-state flips invalidate attestations, contradicting the actual normalization behavior implemented in pass1.py.

The attestation invalidation rules section (~L469) does not document that checkbox states are normalized to '[ ]' before hashing the material fingerprint and thus checkbox flips are not material edits.
The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901) does not clarify that checking boxes to satisfy the precheck is safe for attestation freshness.
Other documentation (e.g., user-guide.md, completion-verifier docs) may contain stale claims that description/checkbox edits invalidate attestations and require alignment.
